leadText:
Lauren (Japanese: ミサキ Misaki) is a character of the day who appeared in The Sinnoh Iceberg Race!. Her hometown is Snowpoint City. She is the first character of the day to appear in .

Lauren first appeared when she contacted the Cerise Laboratory after her found its way to Vermilion City and was brought to the lab by and Goh. The two arranged to bring it to Sinnoh for her. Lauren met them soon after they arrived and was reunited with her Piplup. Afterwards, she explained why Piplup swam away.

Lauren later watched as Piplup and her participated in the Pokémon Iceberg Race. The race was soon interrupted by , who captured all of the participating Pokémon before attacking the ship with their , causing Lauren to cling to the ship and making her lose her glasses. She was saved from falling into the water below when Piplup and Croagunk worked together to cut from the ship a life raft for her to land on. She later waved goodbye to Ash and Goh as they returned to Kanto, only for her glasses to fall into the ocean once again, though they were picked up by a .
